categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Does not touch mempool data structures, policy rules, or fee estimation algorithms; it only adjusts RPC formatting of fee rates.
categories.rationale: The PR changes the presentation format of fee rates in RPC output rather than mempool or fee estimation logic.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Tagged RPC/REST/ZMQ; modifies RPC parameter handling and output formatting across `src/rpc/fees.cpp`, `src/rpc/mempool.cpp`, and `src/rpc/net.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Adds an optional `sat_vb` parameter across fee-related RPC endpoints to eliminate client-side unit conversion and sub-1 sat/vB rounding friction. While addressing a common user pain point, it is an ergonomic enhancement that is reasonably deferrable.
